title: Kazbegi Day Tour from Tbilisi
overview: Discover the breathtaking beauty of Georgia's Military Highway on this private full-day tour to Kazbegi. Visit ancient fortresses, mountain reservoirs, panoramic viewpoints, and the famous Gergeti Trinity Church surrounded by the majestic Caucasus Mountains.
highlights: Scenic drive through the Caucasus Mountains

itinerary.title: Zhinvali Reservoir
itinerary.description: A stunning turquoise reservoir surrounded by mountains — one of Georgia's most beautiful viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Ananuri Fortress
itinerary.description: A medieval fortress dating back to the 16th century, overlooking the Zhinvali Reservoir.

itinerary.title: Black & White Aragvi Rivers
itinerary.description: A unique natural phenomenon where the two rivers flow together while keeping their different colors.

itinerary.title: Gudauri Panorama
itinerary.description: The famous Friendship Monument offers spectacular panoramic views of the Caucasus Mountains.

itinerary.title: Gergeti Trinity Church
itinerary.description: At 2,170 m above sea level beneath Mount Kazbek, this iconic church is one of Georgia's most famous landmarks. Return to Tbilisi in the evening.

title: Borjomi Day Tour from Tbilisi
overview: Explore Georgia's history and nature by visiting Stalin's birthplace, the ancient cave city of Uplistsikhe, and the famous Borjomi National Park.

itinerary.title: Stalin Museum (Gori)
itinerary.description: Learn about the life of Joseph Stalin in his hometown.

itinerary.title: Uplistsikhe Cave Town
itinerary.description: An ancient rock-hewn city dating back over 3,000 years.

itinerary.title: Borjomi Central Park
itinerary.description: Taste the world-famous Borjomi mineral water directly from the natural spring.

itinerary.title: Green Monastery
itinerary.description: A peaceful medieval monastery hidden within a lush forest. Return to Tbilisi.

title: Dashbashi Canyon Day Tour
overview: Visit one of Georgia's newest natural attractions, famous for its spectacular canyon and unique glass bridge.

itinerary.title: Dashbashi Canyon
itinerary.description: A beautiful canyon with waterfalls and dramatic cliffs.

itinerary.title: Diamond Glass Bridge
itinerary.description: Walk across one of Europe's most impressive glass bridges with breathtaking views below. Return to Tbilisi.

title: Martvili Canyon & Prometheus Cave Day Tour
overview: Perfect for nature lovers, this long-distance tour takes you to western Georgia's most spectacular natural attractions.

itinerary.title: Martvili Canyon
itinerary.description: Enjoy emerald-green waters, waterfalls, and optional boat rides through the canyon.

itinerary.title: Prometheus Cave
itinerary.description: Explore one of Europe's largest caves, filled with colorful stalactites, stalagmites, underground rivers, and impressive halls. Return to Tbilisi.

title: Kakheti Wine Day Tour
overview: Experience Georgia's famous wine region, rich history, delicious local food, and beautiful landscapes.

itinerary.title: KTW Winery
itinerary.description: Learn about Georgia's 8,000-year-old winemaking tradition while tasting local wines.

itinerary.title: Churchkhela & Cheese Tasting
itinerary.description: Taste traditional Georgian cheese and the famous sweet snack called churchkhela.

itinerary.title: Bodbe Monastery
itinerary.description: Visit the burial place of Saint Nino, who brought Christianity to Georgia.

itinerary.title: Sighnaghi
itinerary.description: Known as the City of Love, Sighnaghi offers charming streets, city walls, and breathtaking views of the Alazani Valley. Return to Tbilisi.

title: Tbilisi & Mtskheta Day Tour
overview: Discover Georgia's capital city together with its ancient capital, Mtskheta, where history, culture, and religion come together.

itinerary.title: Chronicle of Georgia
itinerary.description: A monumental masterpiece offering incredible views over the Tbilisi Sea.

itinerary.title: Holy Trinity Cathedral (Sameba)
itinerary.description: One of the largest Orthodox churches in the world.

itinerary.title: Mother of Georgia
itinerary.description: The iconic aluminium statue overlooking the city — a sword in one hand, a bowl of wine in the other.

itinerary.title: Bridge of Peace
itinerary.description: A modern glass bridge connecting old and new Tbilisi.

itinerary.title: Clock Tower
itinerary.description: A unique leaning clock tower beside the famous Gabriadze puppet theatre.

itinerary.title: Old Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Walk through colorful streets, historic churches, sulphur baths, and charming cafés.

itinerary.title: Mtskheta
itinerary.description: Georgia's ancient capital and one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.

itinerary.title: Svetitskhoveli Cathedral
itinerary.description: The 11th-century UNESCO cathedral at the heart of Mtskheta — said to hold the robe of Christ and the coronation site of Georgian kings.

itinerary.title: Jvari Monastery
itinerary.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site with spectacular views over the confluence of the Mtkvari and Aragvi rivers. Return to Tbilisi.

title: Tbilisi to Batumi Private Transfer
overview: A private, direct transfer from Tbilisi to Batumi in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle. The drive takes around 6 hours, and because the car is yours you can leave when it suits you and break the journey with optional stops en route.

itinerary.title: Hotel pick-up in Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Depart from your accommodation at a time that suits you.

itinerary.title: Optional stops en route
itinerary.description: On request, break the drive at highlights along the way — Gori, Uplistsikhe, Borjomi or Kutaisi (adds to the total travel time).

itinerary.title: Arrival in Batumi
itinerary.description: Drop-off at your hotel on the Black Sea coast.

title: Georgia Highlights Tour
overview: An eight-day private journey across Georgia with an English-speaking driver-guide: Tbilisi and ancient Mtskheta, the wine region of Kakheti, the Caucasus mountains around Kazbegi, seaside Batumi and Adjara, and the emerald canyons of the west.
excluded: Optional activities (zip line, ATV, boat ride, cable car)

itinerary.title: Day 1 · Discover Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Start your adventure by exploring Georgia's vibrant capital — impressive monuments, centuries-old churches, and charming cobblestone streets where ancient history meets modern life.

itinerary.title: Day 2 · Kakheti Wine Region
itinerary.description: Travel to Georgia's famous wine region and discover its 8,000-year-old winemaking tradition. Taste local wines, cheese and churchkhela, visit the peaceful Bodbe Monastery, and finish in the hilltop town of Sighnaghi over the Alazani Valley. Return to Tbilisi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 · Journey to Kazbegi
itinerary.description: Drive the spectacular Georgian Military Highway, stopping at iconic viewpoints and historical landmarks before arriving in the mountain town of Stepantsminda. Overnight in Kazbegi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 · Explore Kazbegi
itinerary.description: Spend the day in the Greater Caucasus — the iconic Gergeti Trinity Church, a hike to Gveleti Waterfall, the dramatic Dariali Gorge near the Russian border, and views from Mount Elia. Overnight in Kazbegi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 · Kazbegi to Batumi
itinerary.description: Long-distance transfer from Kazbegi to Batumi with a relaxing lunch stop along the way. Overnight stay in Batumi.

itinerary.title: Day 6 · Batumi City Tour
itinerary.description: Discover seaside Batumi — elegant Piazza Square, Europe Square, the iconic Alphabet Tower, a stroll along the palm-lined boulevard, and a ride on the Argo Cable Car for panoramic views of the city, sea and mountains. Overnight in Batumi.

itinerary.title: Day 7 · Adjara Adventure
itinerary.description: Explore the nature of Adjara — the spectacular Makhuntseti Waterfall, a thrilling zip line and ATV ride through mountain scenery, and free time by the sea at Sarpi on the Georgia–Turkey border before returning to Batumi.

itinerary.title: Day 8 · Batumi to Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Travel through western Georgia to two of its most spectacular natural attractions — the emerald waters of Martvili Canyon and the illuminated chambers of Prometheus Cave — before a comfortable hotel drop-off in Tbilisi.

title: Essential Georgia — 3 Days
overview: A perfect long weekend — the capital’s old town, the ancient churches of Mtskheta, and a day in the high Caucasus at Kazbegi.

itinerary.title: Day 1 · Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Arrival, old town walking tour and a first taste of Georgian cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 2 · Tbilisi & Kazbegi
itinerary.description: Travel along the scenic Georgian Military Highway, stopping at Zhinvali Reservoir, Ananuri Fortress, and the iconic Gudauri Panorama before reaching Kazbegi to visit the famous Gergeti Trinity Church. Overnight stay in Kazbegi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 · Kakheti
itinerary.description: Explore Sighnaghi, visit the serene Bodbe Monastery, walk the ancient fortress walls, and enjoy authentic Georgian wine tastings at KTW Winery.

title: Wine & Mountains — 5 Days
overview: The two faces of Georgia — the amber wine cellars of Kakheti and the glaciers of the Greater Caucasus, with the capital in between.
included: Wine tasting at a family cellar

itinerary.title: Day 1 · Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Arrival, old town walking tour and a first taste of Georgian cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 2 · Kakheti
itinerary.description: Explore Sighnaghi, visit the serene Bodbe Monastery, walk the ancient fortress walls, and enjoy authentic Georgian wine tastings at KTW Winery.

itinerary.title: Day 3 · Tbilisi & Kazbegi
itinerary.description: Travel along the scenic Georgian Military Highway, stopping at Zhinvali Reservoir, Ananuri Fortress, and the iconic Gudauri Panorama before reaching Kazbegi to visit the famous Gergeti Trinity Church. Overnight stay in Kazbegi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 · Kazbegi & Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Visit the magnificent Dariali Monastery near the border, then journey back to explore UNESCO World Heritage sites in Mtskheta — Jvari Monastery and Svetitskhoveli Cathedral — before returning to Tbilisi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 · Departure
itinerary.description: A final morning at leisure before your airport drop-off.

title: Grand Georgia — 7 Days
overview: The complete journey coast to mountains — wine country, western canyons, the Black Sea in Batumi and the high Caucasus, all privately guided.
included: Wine tasting at a family cellar

itinerary.title: Day 1 · Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Airport welcome, old town and an evening in the capital.

itinerary.title: Day 2 · Kakheti
itinerary.description: Sighnaghi, Bodbe and qvevri wine tastings across the Alazani Valley.

itinerary.title: Day 3 · Kutaisi & Canyons
itinerary.description: Martvili Canyon by boat and the illuminated halls of Prometheus Cave.

itinerary.title: Day 4–5 · Batumi
itinerary.description: The Black Sea riviera — botanical garden, boulevard and free time by the coast.

itinerary.title: Day 6 · Kazbegi
itinerary.description: The Military Highway to Gergeti Trinity Church beneath the glaciers.

itinerary.title: Day 7 · Departure
itinerary.description: Mtskheta’s churches en route to your airport drop-off.

title: Ultimate Georgia Adventure — 13 Days
location: Tbilisi · Kakheti · Tusheti · Shatili · Kazbegi · Kutaisi · Borjomi
overview: Discover the very best of Georgia on this unforgettable thirteen-day journey. Explore UNESCO World Heritage Sites, taste world-famous Georgian wine, wander through charming mountain villages, and experience the untouched beauty of the Greater Caucasus. From the vibrant streets of Tbilisi to the remote regions of Tusheti and Shatili, this tour offers the perfect combination of culture, history, nature and adventure. Best travelled June to September, when the high mountain passes are open.
excluded: Optional activities (zip line, ATV, boat ride, cable car)

itinerary.title: Day 1 · Welcome to Georgia
itinerary.description: Arrive in Tbilisi, where your private guide meets you at the airport. After checking into your hotel, enjoy a relaxing evening exploring the charming streets of Old Tbilisi, filled with colorful balconies, cozy cafés and breathtaking city views.

itinerary.title: Day 2 · Discover Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Explore Georgia's fascinating capital — the monumental Chronicles of Georgia, Holy Trinity Cathedral, Metekhi Church, Narikala Fortress and the iconic Mother of Georgia statue above the rooftops, then down into the Sulfur Baths district and the hidden Leghvtakhevi Waterfall.

itinerary.title: Day 3 · Kakheti Wine Region
itinerary.description: Head east into Kakheti, Georgia's wine heartland — the peaceful Bodbe Monastery, the hilltop town of Sighnaghi over the Alazani Valley, and a traditional qvevri wine tasting. Overnight in Telavi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 · Into the Wild Tusheti
itinerary.description: One of the most scenic drives in the Caucasus, crossing the breathtaking Abano Pass. Reach Omalo, the heart of Tusheti, surrounded by dramatic mountains and medieval defensive towers. Overnight in Omalo.

itinerary.title: Day 5 · Hidden Villages of Tusheti
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring the untouched villages of Dartlo, Kvavlo and Parsma. Discover ancient stone towers, traditional Tushetian architecture and some of the most spectacular mountain landscapes in Georgia. Overnight in Omalo.

itinerary.title: Day 6 · Return to Tbilisi
itinerary.description: Leave the mountains behind and enjoy another spectacular drive back to Tbilisi. Spend the evening relaxing, exploring the city at your own pace, or enjoying traditional Georgian cuisine.

itinerary.title: Day 7 · Journey to Shatili
itinerary.description: Travel deep into the Khevsureti region via the dramatic Datvisjvari Pass. Visit the mysterious Anatori Necropolis before arriving at the medieval fortress village of Shatili, one of Georgia's most unique mountain settlements. Overnight in Shatili.

itinerary.title: Day 8 · Scenic Drive to Kazbegi
itinerary.description: Drive along the legendary Georgian Military Highway. Stop at the spectacular Gudauri Panorama and enjoy magnificent mountain scenery before arriving in the picturesque town of Stepantsminda (Kazbegi).

itinerary.title: Day 9 · Explore Kazbegi
itinerary.description: Visit the iconic Gergeti Trinity Church, standing proudly beneath Mount Kazbek. Continue to the beautiful Gveleti Waterfall and the dramatic Dariali Gorge near the Georgian–Russian border.

itinerary.title: Day 10 · From Mountains to Western Georgia
itinerary.description: Stop at the turquoise waters of the Jinvali Reservoir and explore the historic Ananuri Fortress before continuing west to Kutaisi, one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in Europe.

itinerary.title: Day 11 · Natural Wonders
itinerary.description: Discover two of western Georgia's greatest natural attractions: the magical Prometheus Cave, filled with colorful underground formations, and Martvili Canyon, where emerald waters flow through stunning limestone cliffs.

itinerary.title: Day 12 · Borjomi & Mtskheta
itinerary.description: Visit Borjomi, famous for its mineral springs and beautiful national park. On the way back to Tbilisi, explore the ancient capital of Mtskheta, including the UNESCO-listed Jvari Monastery and Svetitskhoveli Cathedral.

itinerary.title: Day 13 · Departure
itinerary.description: After an unforgettable journey across Georgia, enjoy your airport transfer and depart with incredible memories of the Caucasus.
